newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan, U.S. to sign "open skies" avaition accord.
newsitem.headline: Jordan, U.S. to sign "open skies" avaition accord.

text.p: Jordan said on Friday it would sign an "open skies" agreement with the United States on Sunday to boost Royal Jordanian's (RJ) passenger traffic from North America.
Transport Minister Nasser al-Lawzi said the agreement would help Jordan's national carrier increase the number of passengers flying to Amman and other destinations in the Middle East.
Lawzi said the accord would let RJ fly "at any frequency with any number of passengers to any U.S. destination" without prior approval.

He said the accord would help in any future privatisation of the carrier. "For privatisation, to have such an agreement is a vote of confidence. It's a good asset to RJ and whoever is going to invest."
Royal Jordanian has a leased fleet of 17 aircraft including five Tristars, nine Airbuses and three Boeing 707 cargo planes. It flies to 48 destinations.
